beats.label: S1 · A blind lawyer opens a firm
beats.text: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened senses, opens a firm with Foggy Nelson; they save secretary Karen Page from a Union Allied frame-up and hire her on.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the three central people and the firm that anchors every future season.

beats.label: S1 · A shadow behind the crime
beats.text: Hunting the man behind the city's crime, Matt discovers Wilson Fisk secretly runs an alliance of Russian, Chinese, and Japanese gangs rebuilding Hell's Kitchen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's antagonist and the criminal alliance whose collapse defines the next season.

beats.label: S1 · Fisk turns on his allies
beats.text: Fisk decapitates the Russian boss Anatoly for embarrassing him in front of gallerist Vanessa Marianna, then destroys the Russians and pins the war on the masked vigilante.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Fisk's temper, his love for Vanessa, and how he frames the vigilante — all payoffs later.

beats.label: S1 · Digging up Fisk's father
beats.text: Reporter Ben Urich and Karen dig into Fisk's past and find his mother, who reveals Fisk murdered his own father as a boy — leverage they hope to publish.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the secret Karen carries into future seasons and uses to break Fisk later.

beats.label: S1 · Karen kills Wesley
beats.text: Cornered by Fisk's right-hand James Wesley over what she knows, Karen shoots him dead — a secret she tells no one and cannot undo.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Karen's private guilt that shadows every subsequent season.

beats.label: S1 · Fisk cleans house
beats.text: Fisk goes public as Hell's Kitchen's savior; on learning Owlsley poisoned Vanessa and Urich threatened his mother, he murders both men himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Fisk consolidating and killing his own — establishes the ruthlessness that drives later revenge arcs.

beats.label: S1 · The Devil of Hell's Kitchen
beats.text: In new armor made by Melvin Potter, Matt beats Fisk in the street and hands him to federal agents; the press names the vigilante 'Daredevil'.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Fisk in prison, names the hero, and leaves the criminal power vacuum the next season opens on.

cliffhanger.text: Fisk is in federal custody and his crime alliance shattered, leaving Hell's Kitchen without a kingpin. Matt now openly fights as Daredevil while Karen carries the secret that she killed Wesley.
questions: Who fills the power vacuum in Hell's Kitchen now that Fisk's alliance has collapsed?
Can Fisk reach beyond a prison cell to strike back at the people who put him there?
How long can Karen keep from her friends that she killed a man?

characters.name: Matt Murdock
characters.line: Blind Hell's Kitchen defense lawyer whose heightened senses let him fight as the newly-named vigilante Daredevil.

characters.name: Foggy Nelson
characters.line: Matt's law partner and best friend; now knows Matt is Daredevil but has chosen to work alongside him anyway.

characters.name: Karen Page
characters.line: The firm's assistant and moral engine of the anti-Fisk investigation; secretly killed Wesley in self-defense and hides it.

characters.name: Wilson Fisk
characters.line: The 'Kingpin' who tried to remake Hell's Kitchen through crime and philanthropy; now publicly exposed and jailed, but not finished.

characters.name: Vanessa Marianna
characters.line: Art gallerist and Fisk's fiancée; fled New York after his arrest, still loyal to him.
characters.note: The one person Fisk protects above all else.

characters.name: Melvin Potter
characters.line: Engineer coerced by Fisk into making armor; now willingly builds Matt's Daredevil suit.

characters.name: Claire Temple
characters.line: Nurse who patched Matt up on rooftops and knows his identity; has stepped away from his life.

characters.name: Madame Gao
characters.line: Enigmatic Chinese heroin operator inside Fisk's alliance; escaped Matt's raid and slipped out of the country.

beats.label: S2 · The Punisher arrives
beats.text: Frank Castle wages a one-man war on Hell's Kitchen's gangs; after nearly killing Matt on a rooftop, the firm takes his case to spare him the death penalty.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Castle, the season's second protagonist, and sets the firm on a losing legal path.

beats.label: S2 · Karen finds the sting
beats.text: Karen digs into Castle's past and finds his family died in a DA sting the office covered up; Castle later hunts down and murders the drug lord 'Blacksmith' responsible.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements Karen and Castle's bond and closes his revenge arc, sending him toward the mantle he keeps.

beats.label: S2 · Elektra returns
beats.text: Elektra Natchios, Matt's thrill-seeking college love, resurfaces asking for help against Roxxon and the Yakuza, and pulls him back into her violent orbit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reintroduces the woman whose fate defines the season's ending and Matt's grief.

beats.label: S2 · The firm fractures
beats.text: Matt's split attention wrecks the Castle trial; Foggy blames Elektra for the loss, and Nelson & Murdock dissolves.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits Matt from Foggy, the professional break the next season has to repair.

beats.label: S2 · Stick and the Hand
beats.text: Stick reveals he groomed Elektra since childhood as a weapon for the Chaste in its ancient war against the Hand, of whom the Yakuza are a front.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Recasts Elektra as an agent of a mythic war and explains the enemy behind the season's second half.

beats.label: S2 · Fisk pulls strings from prison
beats.text: From his cell, Fisk manipulates Castle's escape to weaponize him against rivals, but Castle warns Fisk he will kill him the next time they meet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Fisk building power from inside prison — the setup for how he engineers his own release later.

beats.label: S2 · Elektra dies, Karen learns the truth
beats.text: Elektra dies protecting Matt from the Hand; Foggy leaves for Jeri Hogarth's firm, Matt confesses his identity to Karen, and the Hand exhume Elektra's body.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets every major end-state going in: Elektra dead, Foggy gone, Karen finally knows, and the Hand keep their prize.

cliffhanger.text: Elektra is dead saving Matt but the Hand have stolen her body for their resurrection device. Nelson & Murdock is dissolved, Karen finally knows Matt is Daredevil, and Frank Castle has embraced the Punisher mantle.
questions: What does the Hand intend by resurrecting Elektra?
Can Karen accept the man she loves is the vigilante she has been reporting on?
With Foggy gone and the firm dissolved, who does Matt fight for now?

characters.name: Matt Murdock
characters.line: Daredevil; grieving Elektra, working without Foggy, and finally honest with Karen about who he is.

characters.name: Karen Page
characters.line: Reporter's instincts sharpening at the New York Bulletin; now knows Matt is Daredevil and still hides that she killed Wesley.

characters.name: Foggy Nelson
characters.line: Quit Nelson & Murdock over Matt's lies during the Castle trial; joined Jeri Hogarth's high-end firm.

characters.name: Wilson Fisk
characters.line: Imprisoned but running Ryker's from inside; arranged Frank Castle's escape to weaponize him against his own criminal competitors.

characters.name: Frank Castle
characters.line: The Punisher; former Marine turned executioner after his family died in a police-sting cover-up. Burned his house down and moved on.

characters.name: Elektra Natchios
characters.line: Matt's college love and the Hand's prophesied 'Black Sky'; died saving Matt, her corpse taken by the Hand.

beats.label: S3 · Matt breaks at St. Agnes
beats.text: A gravely injured Matt wakes at the St. Agnes Orphanage under Sister Maggie's care; his faith broken, he decides to abandon 'Matt Murdock' and live only as Daredevil.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's spiritual arc and the domestic setting where Maggie's secret will land.

beats.label: S3 · Fisk trades his way out
beats.text: Fisk trades intel for release into an FBI hotel penthouse; sniper Agent Dex Poindexter earns his trust by executing attackers during a staged transit hit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Fisk back in play and introduces Dex, the season's second antagonist.

beats.label: S3 · Fisk builds his 'Daredevil'
beats.text: Fisk grooms the unstable Dex, has Dex's girlfriend Julie murdered to isolate him, and sends him in a copy of the Daredevil suit to shoot up the New York Bulletin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The frame-up that turns the public against Daredevil and drives the season's core impersonation.

beats.label: S3 · Two revelations at once
beats.text: Karen confronts Fisk and accidentally confirms Matt is Daredevil; that same night Matt overhears Sister Maggie praying and learns she is his mother.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Hands Fisk the identity he has been chasing and reframes Matt's origin.

beats.label: S3 · A murder in a church
beats.text: Dex kills Father Lantom in an attempted hit on Karen at the church; FBI Agent Ray Nadeem, blackmailed into working for Fisk, turns state's witness.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The atrocity that unites the firm against Fisk and gives them their inside man.

beats.label: S3 · Wedding, then war
beats.text: Fisk marries Vanessa; Dex crashes the reception seeking revenge for Julie, and a three-way fight ends with Matt beating Fisk but refusing to kill him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The climactic confrontation and Matt's moral line — he chooses law over murder.

beats.label: S3 · A deal, and a firm reborn
beats.text: Fisk returns to prison in exchange for Matt hiding Vanessa's role in Nadeem's murder; Nadeem's dying video clears Daredevil and the practice reopens as Nelson, Murdock & Page.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The uneasy truce that ends the season and the professional reunion Matt spent two years earning back.

cliffhanger.text: Fisk is back in prison but bought his freedom for Vanessa's silence over Nadeem's murder, and the firm is reborn as Nelson, Murdock & Page. Dex, paralyzed by Fisk, is on a surgeon's table having his spine rebuilt.
questions: Can Matt truly live as both Matt Murdock and Daredevil now that Fisk knows who he is?
What happens when Dex's spine surgery restores a psychopath the system already lost?
How long will the truce hold before Fisk or Vanessa break it?

characters.name: Matt Murdock
characters.line: Reconciled with being both Matt and Daredevil; back at the firm and holding an uneasy truce with Fisk.

characters.name: Karen Page
characters.line: Full partner at Nelson, Murdock & Page; Fisk now knows she killed Wesley and that Matt is Daredevil.

characters.name: Foggy Nelson
characters.line: Left Hogarth's firm and reopened the practice with Matt and Karen after nearly running for district attorney against Fisk.

characters.name: Wilson Fisk
characters.line: Back in prison under an uneasy bargain with Matt; publicly married to Vanessa, still commanding a network on the outside.

characters.name: Vanessa Marianna
characters.line: Fisk's wife, no longer sidelined from his empire; personally ordered Nadeem's murder.

characters.name: Benjamin 'Dex' Poindexter
characters.line: The fake Daredevil — a psychopathic FBI sniper broken by Fisk; paralyzed by him in the finale and now undergoing experimental spinal surgery.

characters.name: Sister Maggie
characters.line: The nun who raised Matt at St. Agnes; revealed to be his mother, back in his life at last.

characters.name: Rahul 'Ray' Nadeem
characters.line: FBI agent who turned on Fisk; killed by Dex, but his recorded testimony exposed Fisk and cleared Daredevil.
